versionTitles.ja: ホイール・オブ・ヘブン訳

subtitles.en: The bnei-elohim council, the divine speeches, behemoth and leviathan

descriptions.en: **Planned** Wheel of Heaven Translation of Job from the pointed Hebrew Masoretic text (Westminster Leningrad Codex, Public Domain). Phase 2 priority. Initial scope: chapters 1–2 (the *bnei-elohim* divine-council scene that is central to the WoH lens) and chapters 38–42 (the divine speeches with the *behemoth* and *leviathan* material). The Dhorme/RNKJV translation divergence the Raëlian canon notes is located in Job 37–38 and will be surfaced explicitly in the commentary.
